description: Get the calls printed in The Durability Curve Weekly: dated, checkable predictions, each with the confidence printed at the time and the date or event it resolves on. Filter by status, ID, issue, resolution date or printed confidence. The wording is exactly as printed and never changes after publication. outcome is null until a call resolves. counts describe the calls returned; record describes every call. These tools retrieve The Durability Curve's public material. They do not certify that any claim is true.

confidence_at_least.description: Only calls printed at this confidence or higher, in percent, e.g. 60.

confidence_at_most.description: Only calls printed at this confidence or lower, in percent, e.g. 30.

id.description: One call by its ID, e.g. "W02-5".

issue.description: Only the calls printed in this issue of the Weekly.

resolves_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only calls whose latest resolution date is after this day, earliest first.

resolves_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Only calls whose latest resolution date is before this day, earliest first. A call that resolves on an event "or" a date counts by that date.

name: get_weekly_calls
title: Get the weekly calls
